title: Mixed Event — Smile of a Dreamer — Episode4 Where's Our Hope?

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime picks up the pace in preparation for their final Show Contest performance! At the same time, Emu learns that her brothers are working on a huge overhaul of Phoenix Wonderland. She tries to convince them to reconsider, but will she be successful?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sorry about my brothers, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You shouldn't be the one apologizing, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. We may've gotten a little too heated with them as well during all that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I believe they also needed to hear what we said.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But what exactly is going on...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How can your brothers say such things...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the next show is the last one for the Show Contest. It would be nice to put as much effort as we can into it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you might be right. I'd be okay with our audience simply enjoying the show but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We've made it this far, so I guess we should try to outdo the Phoenix Stage troupe and win it all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Precisely! This contest is our chance to make Wonderlands×Showtime known throughout the world!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Just a little argument! Don't worry! I know we'll make up in no time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's no way that was something little!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's right. Your brothers are involved in the operations for this park, no? Could it have to do with that...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just made them a little mad and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...! We have practice tomorrow too, so I should go home! Bye, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I want them to do as many shows as they can and sparkle as they smile on stage...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't you get it? You want to make EVERYONE smile, right?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you're so sad now you're almost in tears! Wouldn't your grandpa want YOU to be happy too?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't just dump this on them all at once...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Did you really go and talk to Keisuke and Shosuke right before the inspection...?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: No. I understand how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: It is sad to see everything change like this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is there really no hope left...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really can't keep the promise I made with grandpa...?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Father already made his decision so...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: But I don't think grandpa would be that sad. You valiantly saved the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: People slowly stopped going to the stage and the cast ultimately gave up because of that...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Keisuke, Shosuke and father all agreed that it wasn't earning back what it cost to run it, so they said they had no other choice...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: But you kept on fighting even on your own, right?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You put on shows all by yourself while also going to interview sessions to look for anyone that might help you...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: And you found some friends who would help and actually saved it in the end. That made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I'm sure grandpa would feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're right. I shouldn't give up yet...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The promise I made with grandpa, the memories from when we all went to the park as a family... It's all there. All of it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't want it to change the way it's about to...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I'm very fond of the park as well.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Especially when we could enjoy it together as a family...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Yeah, I have to do this. I have to try and save grandpa's park.)
